article.title: How to Search for Exoplanets
article.excerpt: Two amateur astronomers, Kevin Bond and Ethan Byrd, independently found signals that could point to planets around distant stars. They knew you didn't need your own telescope for this kind of hunt. Kevin used Codex and Ethan used Astra to search public telescope data for tiny, recurring dips in starlight that an orbiting planet can cause. Both found signals worth a second look…

fa.title: چگونه برای جستجو برای Exoplanets
fa.excerpt: دو ستاره شناس آماتور، کوین باند و ایتان Byrd، به طور مستقل سیگنال هایی را پیدا کردند که می تواند به سیارات اطراف ستاره های دور اشاره کند. آنها می دانستند که برای شکار به تلسکوپ خود نیاز ندارید. کوین از Codex استفاده کرد و ایتان از Astra برای جستجوی داده های تلسکوپ عمومی برای شیب های کوچک و تکراری در نور ستاره ای استفاده کرد که یک سیاره مداری می تواند ایجاد کند. هر دو سیگنال را به ارزش نگاه دوم پیدا کردند...

article.title: I asked AI if it was OK to use AI to write an obituary. The answer surprised me | Anna Spargo-Ryan
article.excerpt: Victorian Liberal leader Jess Wilson’s tribute to Molly Meldrum contained heaps of the right words. That is so many years old. I wrote the eulogy to end all eulogies, breaking my own heart with a…

article.title: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to U.S. industrial might — not a champion
article.excerpt: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that what the market cheered Monday, Jensen Huang's White House–backed return as Nvidia's CEO and board member, could prove a giant mistake, exposing the directors to "historic" personal liability from a growing pile of lawsuits and raising the question of whether the country is celebrating a company that has helped put advanced chips in its adversaries' hands.
